column1: # RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv - append-only lesson memory of recipe planner-native-20261107 (RELOCATE_PLANNER_NATIVE): one row per lesson, appended in the same commit as the correction.

column4: the newest C lineage is not the develop main path: precompute_jni.c went through four reviewed hash-pinned-text crates (jni-guard, slot-preflight, borrow-fail, empty-index; each crate's before sha256 is the previous after) and tuple_lookup_jni.c through one (jni-alias); the FILE rows read the last postimages and the main paths are OMIT rows

the pair kernel starts with a closed one-line SPDX comment, which the bitmatrix v3 C header rule refused; v4 writes the M3JDK header closed on its second line for such donors, keeps the open form for a continuing comment, and relocates .c.txt postimages as the C files they pin
column5: first lines: '/* SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 */' and '/* SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0' + 3 lines

column4: CMake's FindJNI of the module requires the AWT component, which the WSL headless OpenJDK lacks (Could NOT find JNI, missing AWT); the gate runs with a full JDK 21 (Temurin) as JAVA_HOME, and every JVM with -XX:-UsePerfData and TMPDIR/HOME/java.io.tmpdir on the scratch disk so nothing is written to the Linux root image
column5: first run: cmake configure failed, the native dumps fell back to the Java path (probe available=false)

column4: the donor kernels compile unchanged under the module's stricter flags (-std=c11 -Wconversion -Wshadow -Wpedantic -Werror) with their javac -h header forced in by -include, so no per-file option is registered
